en.headline: Lee orders acceleration of building maintenance reforms after Wang Fuk Court fire
en.dek: The Chief Executive told officials on Monday to submit amendments to six ordinances as soon as possible following a progress briefing on the independent committee’s recommendations.

zh.headline: 李家超下令加快樓宇維修制度改革 防止宏福苑悲劇重演
zh.dek: 行政長官周一聽取進度匯報後，指示各部門盡快向立法會提交六項法例修訂，全力落實獨立委員會建議。

en.headline: Customs seize HK$68 million in suspected counterfeit goods in Double 11 operation
en.dek: Officers cracked 39 cases and arrested two people after intercepting about 120,000 items bound mainly for the Americas and the Middle East.

zh.headline: 海關「雙十一」行動檢值6800萬元冒牌貨 拘兩人
zh.dek: 海關破獲39宗案件，檢獲約12萬件懷疑冒牌物品，主要準備轉運至美洲及中東地區。

en.headline: Police arrest 47-year-old woman over suspected fake US$100 at San Po Kong bank
en.dek: A Standard Chartered branch on Tai Wo Street alerted officers after staff found one counterfeit note among 71 US dollar bills a customer tried to deposit.

zh.headline: 新蒲崗銀行疑存入偽美鈔 47歲女子被捕
zh.dek: 大有街渣打銀行職員發現顧客擬存入的71張美鈔中有一張100元屬偽鈔後報警，警方以涉嫌行使偽製紙幣拘捕她。

en.headline: Free medical services for Wang Fuk Court fire victims extended to end of April 2027
en.dek: The Health Bureau said Chinese and Western medicine outreaches, free dental dentures and Hospital Authority fee waivers will continue for another four months after the original year-end deadline.

zh.headline: 宏福苑火災受影響居民免費醫療安排延長至明年4月底
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局宣布，中西醫義診、牙醫免費鑲配假牙及醫管局全額醫療費用豁免由原定年底延長四個月至2027年4月30日。

en.headline: Task force dismantles second bid-rigging group involving 15 estates
en.dek: The joint task force said it arrested 33 people and blocked two contracts worth about HK$7.6 million after uncovering deals totalling more than HK$130 million.

zh.headline: 特遣隊再瓦解圍標集團 涉15屋苑工程逾1.3億
zh.dek: 聯合特遣隊表示已拘捕33人，並阻止兩份約760萬元合約，涉案工程合約總額超過1.3億元。

en.headline: Faster Payment System to suspend service for upgrade on 29 November
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the system will be unavailable from 1 am to 11 am on Sunday while Hong Kong Interbank Clearing carries out maintenance.

zh.headline: 轉數快本月29日凌晨1時至早上11時暫停服務
zh.dek: 金管局表示，香港銀行同業結算有限公司將於周日進行系統提升，該時段內轉數快暫停服務。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 27 points at 22384 as auto stocks lag
en.dek: The index ended Monday 0.12 per cent lower after recovering from a morning drop of more than 400 points, with Lenovo among the strongest gainers.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌27點報22384 汽車股受壓
zh.dek: 周一恒生指數收市跌0.12%，早段曾跌逾400點失守22000點，聯想集團升近8%成表現最好藍籌之一。

en.headline: Man from Hangzhou jailed seven months for importing 61200 duty-free cigarettes
en.dek: Customs said the 56-year-old was intercepted at the airport on 28 October with cigarettes valued at about HK$366000 and was also fined HK$1000.

zh.headline: 杭州抵港旅客攜6.1萬支私煙 判囚7個月罰款千元
zh.dek: 海關指56歲男旅客於10月28日在機場被截獲，行李內有約61200支未完稅香煙，市值約36.6萬元。

en.headline: Hong Kong Post warns public of fake websites and messages
en.dek: The postal service said on Monday it had referred to police fake websites and messages impersonating it that ask recipients for personal data or postage payments.

zh.headline: 香港郵政呼籲慎防偽冒網站及短訊
zh.dek: 香港郵政周一表示，已將冒認其名義的虛假網站及要求提供個人資料或支付郵費的短訊電郵轉交警方，並提醒市民官方網站及發送人名稱。

en.headline: Tow truck overturns in Lion Rock Tunnel forcing single-tube traffic
en.dek: A recovery vehicle rolled onto its side in the Kowloon-bound tube around 11:24 am on Monday after striking a barrier, slightly injuring the driver and causing heavy congestion under one-tube two-way running.

zh.headline: 獅子山隧道往九龍方向拖車翻側 實施單管雙程行車
zh.dek: 周一上午約11時24分，一輛拖車在獅子山隧道往九龍方向管道內疑失控撞石壆後翻側，司機輕傷拒送院，運輸署實施單管雙程行車，交通擠塞。

en.headline: Hang Seng falls to near 19-month low as AI sell-off weighs on tech shares
en.dek: The index dropped as much as 1.8 per cent in morning trade on Monday, with the tech gauge down more than 1 per cent amid continued pressure from US AI stock declines.

zh.headline: 恒指一度跌穿22000點 科技股受AI拋售拖累
zh.dek: 周一早市恒生指數最多跌1.8%，科技指數跌逾1%，延續美股人工智能股跌勢影響。

en.headline: Police announce citywide no-fly zone for Interpol General Assembly next week
en.dek: From 30 November to 3 December, drones, helicopters, kites and other aerial activities will be banned across Hong Kong, with roads closed around the Wan Chai venue.

zh.headline: 國際刑警全體大會下周舉行 全港設臨時禁飛區
zh.dek: 警方宣布，11月30日至12月3日期間全港禁止無人機、直升機、風箍等空中活動，灣仔會展一帶封路。

en.headline: Symphony Orchestra Interflow opens at Cultural Centre with school ensembles
en.dek: The Music Office said about 60 primary and secondary school orchestras will perform from today until 25 November at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Concert Hall, with tickets at HK$80.

zh.headline: 青年音樂匯演交響樂團項目今日起在文化中心舉行
zh.dek: 音樂事務處表示，約60隊中小學樂團由今日至25日在香港文化中心音樂廳演出，門票80元。

en.headline: Observatory cancels Strong Monsoon Signal after morning winds ease
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Strong Monsoon Signal was cancelled at 12:45 pm on Monday as easterly winds moderated.

zh.headline: 天文台取消強烈季候風信號 上午風勢緩和
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，強烈季候風信號於周一中午12時45分取消，偏東風勢減弱。

en.headline: Second domestic large cruise ship Adora Flora City arrives at Kai Tak
en.dek: China's second domestically built large cruise ship, carrying more than 3,800 passengers, arrived at Kai Tak Cruise Terminal on its maiden commercial voyage from Guangzhou.

zh.headline: 第二艙國產大型郵輪愛達・花城號抵達啟德郵輪碼頭
zh.dek: 中國第二艙國產大型郵輪載逾3800名旅客，於商業首航期間今早抵達啟德郵輪碼頭。

en.headline: Development Bureau proposes new category for large building maintenance works
en.dek: Permanent Secretary Doris Ho said approval times for major maintenance projects are expected to lengthen, with a target of completing reviews within 45 days of full submissions.

zh.headline: 發展局擬將大型樓宇維修列新類別 審批時間料較長
zh.dek: 發展局常任秘書長何珮玲表示，大型維修工程審批時間預計較以往長，目標在交齊文件後45日內完成。

en.headline: Government appoints Chan Kin-por as Hospital Authority chairman
en.dek: The Chief Executive appointed Chan Kin-por as chairman of the Hospital Authority for a two-year term from 1 December, with one new member and six reappointments.

zh.headline: 政府委任陳健波為醫管局主席 12月1日起任期兩年
zh.dek: 行政長官根據《醫院管理局條例》委任陳健波為醫管局主席，任期由12月1日起為期兩年，同時委任一名新成員及再度委任六名現任成員。

en.headline: deTour 2026 design festival continues at PMQ until 29 November
en.dek: PMQ said the free annual design festival, themed Better Not Perfect: Prototypes for Tomorrow, features 14 works across three zones and a new pop-up shop.

zh.headline: deTour 2026設計節於元創方持續至11月29日
zh.dek: 元創方表示，免費年度設計節以「不完美，更美好」為主題，設三大展區展出14件作品，並首設快閃選物店。

en.headline: Observatory updates Strong Monsoon Signal with easterly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force with strong easterly winds expected and occasional gale-force gusts.

zh.headline: 天文台更新強烈季候風信號 吹偏東強風
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，強烈季候風信號現正生效，預料吹偏東強風，陣風間中達烈風程度。

en.headline: Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances exhibition continues at Cultural Centre
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the free exhibition under the theme Convergence of Cross-Cultural Gifting runs until 29 November in Tsim Sha Tsui.

zh.headline: 亞裔民族文化表演展於文化中心持續舉行至11月29日
zh.dek: 康文署表示，免費展覽以「跨文化饋贈的匯聚」為主題，於尖沙咀香港文化中心舉行。

en.headline: MegaBox opens Christmas Music Hall with corgi Mochi as resident singer
en.dek: The Kowloon Bay mall said its L5 atrium becomes a vintage record room from today until 3 January, with a six-metre music tree and golden Christmas forest on the rooftop garden.

zh.headline: MegaBox聖誕音樂館開幕 哥基麻粑化身駐場歌手
zh.dek: 九龍灣MegaBox表示，L5中庭由今日起至1月3日化身復古唱片室，設6米高音樂聖誕樹，頂層空中花園則變金色聖誕叢林。

en.headline: MTR fixes signal fault near Ho Man Tin after brief Kwun Tong Line delays
en.dek: The MTR Corporation said trains slowed past a signalling equipment failure near Ho Man Tin Station around 9am, adding 10 to 15 minutes to journeys before service returned to normal.

zh.headline: 何文田站附近信號故障 觀塘綫一度需額外10至15分鐘
zh.dek: 港鐵表示，周一早上約9時何文田站附近信號設備故障，列車需慢駛，觀塘綫行車時間一度增加10至15分鐘，約10分鐘後恢復正常。

en.headline: Police arrest driver after BMW mounts pavement in Tsim Sha Tsui killing one
en.dek: A 38-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of drink-driving and dangerous driving causing death after a private car hit four pedestrians on Prat Avenue on Sunday.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀寶勒巷寶馬劎行人路釀ᴻ死3傷 38歲男司機涉酒駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方表示，一名38歲男子周日傍晚因涉嫌酒後駕駛及危險駕駛導致他人死亡被捕，涉事私家車於寶勒巷衝上行人路。

en.headline: Saltwater main bursts in Tsuen Wan sending jet up to 10 metres high
en.dek: Water Supplies Department staff shut off the valve after a rupture on Tai Pa Street early Monday disrupted traffic and damaged the pavement.

zh.headline: 荃灣大壩街鹹水管爆裂 水柱一度高達約10米
zh.dek: 水務署人員清晨到場關閉水揇，路面被沖出約一米乘一米的洞，交通一度受影響。

en.headline: Driver climbs from overturned van on Lin Cheung Road after early-morning crash
en.dek: Police said a 50-year-old man sustained abrasions to his hands and legs after his seven-seater hit a barrier near West Kowloon Station and flipped, but he declined hospital treatment.

zh.headline: 油麻地連翔道七人車撞壆翻側 司機自行爬出擦傷拒送院
zh.dek: 警方表示，周一凌晨約1時38分一輛七人車在西九龍站對開隧道自炒撞向石壆後四輪朝天，50歲男司機手腳擦傷，現場治理後毋須送院。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts temperatures falling to 16 degrees midweek
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said a northeast monsoon would bring cooler weather from Tuesday, with urban temperatures between 16 and 20 degrees on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 天文台預料周中氣溫跌至16度
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，東北季候風明日抵達華南沿岸，周三市區氣溫介乎16至20度，早晚清涼。

en.headline: Primary One discretionary place results released today for 2027 intake
en.dek: The Education Bureau said 18,148 of 32,104 applicants received discretionary places, with results available from 10am on the e-platform or at schools.

zh.headline: 小一自行分配學位結果今日公布 進讀二〇二七年小一
zh.dek: 教育局表示，全港官立及資助小學小一入學自行分配學位結果今日公布，家長可於上午10時起透過電子平台或到學校查閱。

en.headline: Causeway Bay Winter Wonderland opens 25 November with elf-themed lights
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said the Lee Gardens area will host light shows from 7pm to 10pm and an outdoor bar as part of the expanded WinterFest until 3 January.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣冬日仙境25日開幕 精靈主題燈飾亮相利園區
zh.dek: 旅發局表示，利園區將由晚上7時至10時有燈光表演，並設戶外酒吧，作為擴大版冬日巡禮的一部分，至1月3日結束。

en.headline: One Stanley developer reports alleged extortion bid to police
en.dek: K&K Property said it reported an alleged extortion attempt involving tens of millions of dollars to police on November 4, as investigations continue into substandard construction at the luxury estate.

zh.headline: 建灝地產稱遭勒索已報警 涉及One Stanley缺鋼筋事件
zh.dek: 赤柱豪宅One Stanley發展商建灝地產發言人表示，公司於11月4日就一宗懷疑勒索案向警方報案，金額據悉達數千萬元。

en.headline: Police arrest man after dog found hanging from tree on Tai Po trail
en.dek: A 54-year-old man was arrested on Sunday evening on suspicion of cruelty to animals after his sister reported finding a dog hanging lifeless from a tree outside their stone hut on the Wilson Trail.

zh.headline: 大埔衞奕信徑唐狗被吊樹上死亡 警方拘捕54歲男子涉虐畜
zh.dek: 一名57歲女子周日中午報案，指胞弟飼養的唐狗被吊在石屋外樹上氣絕，警方晚上以涉嫌殘酷對待動物拘捕54歲胞弟。

en.headline: Election Committee counting completes with results published after record turnout
en.dek: The Electoral Affairs Commission said counting finished at 10.15pm on Sunday; Chief Executive John Lee congratulated the winners.

zh.headline: 選委會點票順利完成 結果已公布 投票率達98.79%
zh.dek: 選舉管理委員會表示，點票工作於周日晚上10時15分完成；行政長官李家超恭賀所有當選人。

en.headline: Hong Kong actors Anson Kong and Angela Yuen win at Golden Horse Awards
en.dek: Mirror member Anson Kong took best supporting actor for We're Nothing at All, while Angela Yuen won best actress; We Are Born Good claimed best narrative feature.

zh.headline: 香港演員江⸹生及袁澧林奪金馬獎 善男信女獲最佳劇情片
zh.dek: Mirror成員江⸹生憑《我們不是什麼》奪最佳男配角，袁澧林奪最佳女主角；《善男信女》奪最佳劇情片。

en.headline: CHP investigates invasive meningococcal infection in 74-year-old man
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the patient, who has an underlying illness, is in stable condition at Kwong Wah Hospital after no travel during the incubation period.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查74歲男子感染侵入性腦膜炎雙球菌
zh.dek: 中心指該名有長期病患的患者目前在廣華醫院情況穩定，潛伏期內沒有外遊，初步屬散發個案。

en.headline: Election Committee results begin to emerge after 98.79 per cent turnout
en.dek: Counting continues at the Convention Centre; the Law Society president and General Chamber chief executive were not among those elected in their subsectors.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉點票結果陸續公布 投票率達98.79%
zh.dek: 會展中央點票站繼續點票；律師會會長湯文龍及總商會總裁楊偉添在所屬界別落選。

en.headline: Police investigate theft of rings and cash worth about HK$250,000 from Ho Man Tin flat
en.dek: A 46-year-old woman reported that two rings and about HK$2,000 in cash were missing from her King's Park Hill residence after she discovered the loss on Sunday morning.

zh.headline: 何文田京士柏山單位失竊 兩戒指及現金共約25萬元
zh.dek: 警方表示，46歲女住戶周日早上報稱寓所內兩枚戒指及約2000元現金不見，案件列作盜竊。

en.headline: Customs seize 37.3kg cannabis in two airport drug cases, charge two men
en.dek: Hong Kong Customs said officers seized about 37.3 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds valued at about HK$8 million in two cases at the airport.

zh.headline: 海關機場破兩宗藏毒案 檢37.3公斤大麻花 兩男被控
zh.dek: 香港海關在機場兩宗案件中檢獲約37.3公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約800萬港元，兩名男子已被控。

en.headline: Election Committee polls close with 98.79 per cent turnout as counting begins
en.dek: Officials said 5,640 of 5,709 eligible electors voted by 6pm on Sunday; Electoral Affairs Commission chairman David Lok called the result encouraging.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉投票結束 投票率98.79% 點票展開
zh.dek: 選舉事務處公布，截至周日傍晚6時共5640人投票，投票率達98.79%；選管會主席陸啟康指結果令人鼓舞。

en.headline: Election Committee turnout reaches 98.37 per cent by 5pm
en.dek: Official figures show 5,616 of 5,709 eligible electors have voted as of 5pm on Sunday, with polls set to close at 6pm.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉截至下午5時投票率98.37%
zh.dek: 選舉事務處公布，截至周日下午5時，5709名合資格投票人中已有5616人投票，累積投票率達98.37%，投票站將於下午6時結束。

en.headline: Malaysia wins two titles as Hong Kong Open badminton finals conclude
en.dek: Anders Antonsen took the men's singles by walkover, Wang Zhiyi defended the women's singles, and Malaysian pairs claimed both doubles crowns at Kai Tak Arena.

zh.headline: 香港羽毛球公開賽決賽完結 馬來西亞奪兩項冠軍
zh.dek: 安德斯·安東森因對手退賽獲男單冠軍，王祉怡衛冕女單，馬來西亞組合奪得男雙及女雙，賽事在啟德體育園舉行。

en.headline: Omart warehouse supermarket opens at MegaBox with long queues
en.dek: The membership-based store from OB Group occupies over 20,000 square feet on the 12th floor of MegaBox in Kowloon Bay and opened on Sunday.

zh.headline: Omart倉儲式超市於九龍灣MegaBox開幕 門外排長龍
zh.dek: 由OB Group營運的會員制超市佔用MegaBox 12樓逾2萬平方呎空間，周日正式開業。

en.headline: Election Committee turnout reaches 95.60 per cent by 3pm
en.dek: Official figures show 5,458 of 5,709 eligible electors have voted as of 3pm on Sunday, surpassing the final turnout of the previous election.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉截至下午3時投票率95.60%
zh.dek: 選舉事務處公布，截至周日下午3時，5709名合資格投票人中已有5458人投票，累積投票率達95.60%，已超越上屆最終投票率。

en.headline: Man arrested after car mounts pavement in Tsim Sha Tsui, killing one and injuring three
en.dek: Police said a private car mounted the pavement on Prat Avenue at about 2.30pm on Sunday; one pedestrian died and three others were injured. A man has been arrested.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀寶勒巷私家車剷上行人路 一死三傷 一男子被捕
zh.dek: 警方表示，周日下午約2時半，一輛私家車在寶勒巷剷上行人路，造成一名途人死亡、三人受傷。一名男子已被拘捕。

en.headline: Election Committee turnout reaches 89.81 per cent by 1pm
en.dek: A total of 5,127 voters have cast ballots out of 5,709 eligible electors as of 1pm on Sunday, according to official figures.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉截至下午1時投票率89.81%
zh.dek: 選舉事務處公布，截至周日下午1時，5709名合資格投票人中已有5127人投票，累積投票率達89.81%。

en.headline: Hong Kong-Chile working holiday scheme expected to start in first half of 2027
en.dek: Labour Secretary Chris Sun said the bilateral scheme, Hong Kong’s first with a Latin American country, will offer 100 places a year each way.

zh.headline: 港智工作假期計劃料明年上半年落實
zh.dek: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡表示，這是香港與拉丁美洲國家首個工作假期安排，每年雙方各有100個名額。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts cooler midweek as northeast monsoon arrives
en.dek: A fresh northeast monsoon is expected to reach the south China coast on Tuesday, bringing rain and lower temperatures through midweek.

zh.headline: 天文台料周二東北季候風抵港 本周中期轉涼有雨
zh.dek: 一股清勁東北季候風預料周二抵達華南沿岸，本周中期氣溫下降及有幾陣雨，其後天氣逐漸好轉。

en.headline: Election Committee turnout reaches 69.61 per cent by 11am
en.dek: A total of 3,974 voters have cast ballots out of 5,709 eligible electors as of 11am on Sunday, according to official figures.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉截至上午11時投票率69.61%
zh.dek: 選舉事務處公布，截至周日上午11時，5709名合資格投票人中已有3974人投票，累積投票率達69.61%。

en.headline: Election Committee voting underway as Tang inspects polling stations
en.dek: Polls opened at 9am on Sunday for 856 candidates contesting 723 seats; Security Secretary Chris Tang visited two stations this morning.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉投票進行中 鄧炳強巡視票站
zh.dek: 周日上午九時開始投票，856名候選人競逐723席；保安局局長鄧炳強今早到訪兩個票站視察。

en.headline: Maritime Carnival continues at Hong Kong Maritime Museum this weekend
en.dek: Free mini carnival and art container exhibition run at the museum's Anchor Plaza in Central, with free museum admission on 21 and 22 November.

zh.headline: 海事嘉年華於香港海事博物館繼續舉行
zh.dek: 免費小型嘉年華及藝術貨櫃展覽於中環賽馬會海事廣場舉行，21及22日博物館免費開放。

en.headline: Observatory expects cooler midweek weather as northeast monsoon arrives
en.dek: A fresh northeast monsoon is forecast to reach the south China coast on Tuesday, bringing a few rain patches and lower temperatures.

zh.headline: 天文台料周二東北季候風抵港 本周中期轉涼有雨
zh.dek: 一股清勁東北季候風預料周二抵達華南沿岸，本周中期氣溫下降及有幾陣雨。

en.headline: Observatory issues Yellow Fire Danger Warning as risk rises
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Yellow Fire Danger Warning at 6am on Sunday, advising the public and hikers to take precautions against fires.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 火險頗高
zh.dek: 香港天文台周日上午六時發出黃色火災危險警告，提醒市民及遠足人士採取防火措施，郊野火險頗高。

en.headline: deTour 2026 design festival continues at PMQ in Central
en.dek: Free exhibition of 14 prototypes under the theme Better, Not Perfect runs until 29 November from 11am to 8pm.

zh.headline: deTour 2026設計節於中環PMQ元創方繼續舉行
zh.dek: 以「不完美，更美好」為主題的免費展覽展出14件原型作品，活動至11月29日，每日上午11時至晚上8時開放。

en.headline: Air Niugini flight from Hong Kong lands safely in Philippines after engine fire alert
en.dek: All 146 passengers and crew evacuated uninjured after the Boeing 767 diverted to Davao early Saturday following a right-engine fire indication.

zh.headline: 香港起飛新幾內亞航空客機引擎火警 菲律賓達沃安全降落
zh.dek: 波音767客機載有146人，因右引擎火警指示緊急降落達沃，全員經逃生滑梯撤離，無人受傷。

en.headline: Free Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances carnival opens at Cultural Centre today
en.dek: Performers from around 30 countries gather at the Tsim Sha Tsui piazza from 2pm to 6pm under the theme Blessings in Full Bloom.

zh.headline: 亞洲民族文化表演嘉年華今日尖沙咀文化中心免費舉行
zh.dek: 約30個國家及地區表演者下午二時至六時在廣場演出，主題為「福滿綻放」。

en.headline: Election Committee subsector polls open today from 9am to 6pm
en.dek: 856 candidates contest 723 seats across 31 subsectors at five ordinary polling stations; voters must bring original HKID.

zh.headline: 選委會界別分組選舉今日舉行 投票時間上午九時至下午六時
zh.dek: 856名候選人競逐31個界別分組723個席位，五個一般投票站開放，投票人須帶備香港身份證正本。

en.headline: Atsuko Okatsuka performs Big Bowl Tour at AsiaWorld-Expo tonight
en.dek: The comedian takes the stage at Runway 11 at 8pm, with seated tickets priced from HK$580 to HK$780.

zh.headline: Atsuko Okatsuka今晚於亞洲博覽館上演Big Bowl Tour
zh.dek: 喜劇演員晚上八時在11號館演出，座位票價由580港元至780港元。

en.headline: Asian Gaelic Games mark 30th anniversary at Tseung Kwan O training centre
en.dek: More than 700 athletes from across Asia and Ireland are competing in Gaelic football, hurling and camogie this weekend at the Jockey Club HKFA Football Training Centre.

zh.headline: 亞洲蓋爾克運動會於將軍澳訓練中心迎來30周年
zh.dek: 逾700名來自亞洲及愛爾蘭的運動員週末於將軍澳賽馬會足球訓練中心參與蓋爾克足球、曲棍球及女子曲棍球比賽。

en.headline: Observatory issues Red Fire Danger Warning as risk reaches extreme
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Red Fire Danger Warning at 6am on Saturday, warning that the countryside is extremely vulnerable to fire.

zh.headline: 天文台發出紅色火災危險警告 火險極高
zh.dek: 香港天文台於周六上午六時發出紅色火災危險警告，指郊野火險極高，市民外出需採取防火措施。

en.headline: Chief Executive inspects Wan Chai polling station ahead of Election Committee vote
en.dek: John Lee visited Harbour Road Sports Centre this afternoon and urged eligible voters to cast ballots tomorrow in the contest for 723 seats.

zh.headline: 行政長官視察灣仔票站 選委會選舉明日舉行
zh.dek: 李家超今午到港灣道體育館了解準備情況，呼籲合資格投票人明日踴躍投票，選出723名委員。

en.headline: Major regional sports law body to establish Hong Kong headquarters by year end
en.dek: Deputy Secretary for Justice Horace Cheung said a major regional sports law organisation will set up its base in the city within this year.

zh.headline: 主要區域體育法律機構將於年底前在港設立總部
zh.dek: 律政司副司長張國鈞表示，一個主要區域體育法律機構將於今年內在香港設立總部。

en.headline: Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank to open office in Hong Kong
en.dek: The government and the bank signed agreements on Saturday; Hong Kong will contribute a further US$20 million to the bank's project preparation fund.

zh.headline: 亞投行將在港設辦公室 陳茂波指彰顯國際金融中心地位
zh.dek: 中央政府與亞投行周六簽署協定奠定設辦基礎，香港再向項目準備特別基金注資2000萬美元。

en.headline: Five students injured by falling concrete at Kwai Chung school
en.dek: Police are treating the case as an accidental injury after the students were taken to hospital with light injuries including eye and head complaints.

zh.headline: 葵涌裘錦秋中學工程石屎墮下 五名學生輕傷送院
zh.dek: 警方列作有人意外受傷處理，學生報頭痛、耳痛及眼部受傷，已送瑪嘉烈醫院治理。

en.headline: Police appeal for information on 72-year-old woman missing in Tai Po
en.dek: So Sau-chun was last seen early yesterday on Yuen Shan Road; she is described as about 1.6 metres tall and was wearing black clothing.

zh.headline: 大埔72歲女子失蹤 警方呼籲市民提供消息
zh.dek: 蘇秀珍昨日凌晨在完善路最後露面，身高約1.6米，身穿黑色外套及長褲。

en.headline: Customs seize four suspected endangered turtles in US parcel at airport
en.dek: Officers found the live animals inside a package declared as a toy gift box; the case has been passed to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲四隻懷疑瀕危活龜 包裹由美國進口
zh.dek: 人員在一件報稱為玩具禮盒的包裹內發現四隻活龜，估計市值約四千元，案件已轉交漁護署。

en.headline: Customs arrest 61-year-old over counterfeit perfume operation involving HK$6 million
en.dek: A father was held after officers raided a Kwun Tong unit last week and seized about 800 suspected fake luxury items; his son remains overseas.

zh.headline: 海關破觀塘網店售冒牌香水案 拘61歲父親 兒子在逃
zh.dek: 海關上周三突擊觀塘工廈單位，檢獲約800件懷疑冒牌香水及公仔，涉犯罪得益約600萬元。

en.headline: Police use drones to record 42 double-white-line offences in Southern District
en.dek: Officers from the Hong Kong Island Traffic Unit targeted Stanley Gap Road and Victoria Road during Operation Torch today.

zh.headline: 警方南區以無人機執法 錄得42宗橫越雙白線
zh.dek: 港島總區交通部今日展開「火炬」行動，於赤柱峽道及域多利道以高空錄影搜集證據。

en.headline: Commerce chief says China-US-Russia consensus positive for Hong Kong economy
en.dek: Algernon Yau said the joint peace declaration from the APEC summit sends a positive message but urged cautious optimism as issues cannot be resolved overnight.

zh.headline: 商務局長指中美俄共識對香港經濟正面
zh.dek: 姚英華表示，APEC峰會期間三國領袖發出的和平宣言釋放正面訊息，但問題不可能一跄而就，須保持審慎樂觀。

en.headline: Alex Fong passes 14 km mark in Hong Kong to Macau charity swim
en.dek: The former Olympian started from Peaked Hill on Lantau at about 9 a.m. and had exited Hong Kong waters by early afternoon, aiming to finish the 35 km crossing in about nine hours.

zh.headline: 方力申港澳慈善游已完成逾14公里 游出香港水域
zh.dek: 前奧運泳手今早約九時由大嶼山雞翼角出發，中午已完成12公里並完成首次補給，下午初段已游出香港水域，目標約九小時橫渡35公里抵達澳門。

en.headline: Sports dispute resolution summit set for 1 December with free registration
en.dek: The Department of Justice, Law Society and Bar Association will co-host the event to promote Hong Kong as an international centre for sports dispute resolution.

zh.headline: 體育爭議解決高峰會十二月一日舉行 免費登記現已開放
zh.dek: 律政司、律師會及大律師公會合辦高峰會，展現香港成為國際體育爭議解決中心的優勢，名額有限先到先得。

en.headline: Tourism chief confident visitor arrivals can exceed 55 million this year
en.dek: Rosanna Law said Hong Kong recorded more than 45.8 million arrivals in the first 10 months, a 12 percent rise, and expects the full-year total to top the original 53.8 million target.

zh.headline: 羅淑佩料全年訪港旅客可突破5500萬人次
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩表示，今年首十個月錄得逾4580萬人次訪港旅客，按年升12%，有信心全年可超過原先5380萬目標。

en.headline: Motorcyclist injured after hitting pothole on West Kowloon Highway
en.dek: A 54-year-old rider was taken to Princess Margaret Hospital after his motorcycle overturned near V Walk on Friday afternoon; police are investigating.

zh.headline: 西九龍公路電單車轆坑洞翻側 鐵騎士受傷送院
zh.dek: 54歲李姓男子周五下午於V Walk對開路段因路面殘缺人車倒地，清醒送瑪嘉烈醫院，警方調查中。

en.headline: Three charities hold regional flag days across Hong Kong this morning
en.dek: The Social Welfare Department said Alzheimer's Disease Association, Guide Dogs Association and Society for Abandoned Animals will sell flags until 12.30pm.

zh.headline: 三間慈善機構今早分區賣旗籌款至中午
zh.dek: 社會福利署表示，香港認知障礙症協會、香港導盲犬協會及保護遺棄動物協會將於上午七時至中午十二時半賣旗。

en.headline: Observatory cancels Cold Weather Warning as temperatures ease
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Cold Weather Warning at 6 a.m. today after it was issued on Friday morning.

zh.headline: 天文台取消寒冷天氣警告 氣溫回升
zh.dek: 香港天文台今早六時取消星期五上午發出的寒冷天氣警告。

en.headline: The Big Picnic returns to Discovery Bay beach after seven-year break
en.dek: The community music festival runs from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. today at Tai Pak Beach, with more than 20 bands, food stalls and a kids zone.

zh.headline: The Big Picnic時隔七年重返愉景灣大白灣沙灘
zh.dek: 社區音樂節今日上午十一時至晚上十時於大白灣舉行，有逾二十支樂隊、美食攤檔及兒童專區。

en.headline: Government strongly rejects USCC 2026 report on Hong Kong
en.dek: The SAR Government condemned the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission report as biased and urged the United States to stop interfering in Hong Kong affairs.

zh.headline: 特區政府強烈譴責美中經濟與安全審議委員會報告
zh.dek: 政府形容報告失實偏頗，敦促美國立即停止干涉純屬中國內政的香港事務。

en.headline: Hong Kong China face Tonga in double-header at Kai Tak today
en.dek: Women’s international at 2 p.m. and men’s Nations Cup fixture at 5 p.m. at Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground, with tickets from HK$100.

zh.headline: 港中國欖球隊今於啟德迎戰湯加 男女雙賽
zh.dek: 女子國際賽下午二時開波，男子Nations Cup決賽圈下午五時，啟德青年運動場，門票由100元起。

en.headline: Research Grants Council hosts free AI lectures at Science Museum today
en.dek: Two Cantonese sessions on fact-checking and sports education run from 2:30 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. with free first-come seating.

zh.headline: 研資局與科學館今午舉辦免費人工智能公眾講座
zh.dek: 兩場粵語講座分別談事實查核及體育教學，下午二時半至四時半於尖沙咀舉行，免費入場先到先得。

en.headline: City Kids Christmas Fair returns to Mid-Levels campus today
en.dek: The not-for-profit preschool opens its free annual fundraiser from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Grade II listed building on Borrett Road.

zh.headline: City Kids聖誕嘉年華今午半山舉行 免費開放公眾參與
zh.dek: 非牟利幼稚園於波老道二級歷史建築校園舉辦年度籌款活動，上午十時至下午二時，無需登記。

en.headline: Chief Secretary chairs first meeting of AI risk governance working group
en.dek: Chan Kwok-ki said the group will coordinate seven actions covering AI crime, minor protection, ethical risks and employment impacts.

zh.headline: 陳國基主持人工智能風險管治統籌工作組首次會議
zh.dek: 政務司司長表示，工作組將統籌七項行動，涵蓋打擊AI犯罪、保護未成年使用者及研究就業影響。

en.headline: Government proposes higher building safety penalties after Tai Po fire
en.dek: Development Bureau paper to LegCo suggests maximum fine of HK$10 million and five years' jail for dangerous works, and a new category for large-scale maintenance.

zh.headline: 政府擬修例提高樓宇安全罰則 大型維修工程需事先許可
zh.dek: 發展局向立法會提交文件，建議危險工程最高罰款1000萬元及監禁五年，並為大型樓宇維修設立新規管類別。

en.headline: Hong Kong joins global drug standards body as regulatory member
en.dek: The Health Bureau said Hong Kong became the 20th regulatory member of the ICH after approval at a Czech Republic assembly on 17 November.

zh.headline: 香港正式加入國際人用藥品註冊技術協調會成為監管成員
zh.dek: 醫務衛生局表示，香港在11月17日捷克大會上獲接納為ICH第20個監管機構成員。

en.headline: Zurich Insurance reports unauthorised access to customer portal affecting over 38,000
en.dek: The Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data said 38,453 people may have been affected; the company has taken its customer portal offline.

zh.headline: 蘇黎世保險客戶平台遭未授權存取 私隱公署稱或影響逾3.8萬人
zh.dek: 個人資料私隱專員公署表示，事件或影響38,453人的個人資料；公司已暫停客戶網上平台。
